445.text: "After all we've been through together? Well, I guess the trial of the century is quite a formal occasion."

449.speaker: Narrator
449.text: He looked more haggard than he had at Petr's villa. When he removed his hat, I saw a bald spot on the back of his head.

457.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
457.text: "By the way, I'm sorry I couldn't attend Mr. Vectern's funeral. I always liked the man."

459.speaker: Player
459.text: "No apology necessary. I'm sure Gasom has kept you busy."

460.speaker: Player
460.text: "Everyone did. But he had his dark side."

464.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
464.text: "By the way, I was sorry to hear about Mrs. Rayne. Welcome to the club of divorced Sordish presidents."

465.speaker: Player
465.text: "No need to be sorry. I'm a free man now."

466.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
466.text: "I couldn't stay home and miss the trial of the century. I still can't believe you got the old man indicted."

468.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
468.text: "The trial of the century, they're calling it. I must say I have mixed feelings about this."

469.speaker: Player
469.text: "It's no wonder neither of us could hold on to a wife. Sordland is a demanding mistress."

470.speaker: Player
470.text: "I'm not quite ready to talk about it yet."

471.speaker: Player
471.text: "At least yours left you after you'd already lost the presidency. I'm worried about my public opinion."

477.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
477.text: "That's a conversation for another day, Mr. President."

479.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
479.text: "Actually, I'm a retiree now. I can rest easy, knowing my legacy is safe."

480.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
480.text: "Of course. It must be a difficult time for you."

484.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
484.text: "So I won't bring up the whole Gasom quagmire. That's a conversation for another day."

488.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
488.text: "Albeit in foreign hands. But that's a conversation for another day."

490.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
490.text: "You really do have a heart of stone, don't you, Rayne?"
490.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Confrontation_USP_EnergyAct_RevertedTo10"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_10Percent"] == true

492.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
492.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Confrontation_USP_EnergyAct_RevertedTo10"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_10Percent"] == true

493.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
493.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Confrontation_USP_EnergyAct_RevertedTo10"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_10Percent"] == true) == false

494.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
494.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Confrontation_USP_EnergyAct_RevertedTo10"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_10Percent"] == true) == false

495.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
495.text: "I understand. I was a mess after my wife left. Thank God it didn't happen while I was still in office."

496.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
496.text: "I take it you're finally beginning to understand all the challenges I was up against."

497.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
497.text: "Ha. No president of Sordland is ever free. Once this country has you in its grip, there's no wriggling out."

501.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
501.text: "I know it's a difficult time for you, so I'll refrain from bringing up the whole Gasom quagmire. That's a conversation for another day."

502.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
502.text: "But how have you been? Still trying to lead Sordland out of the mess I made?"

506.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
506.text: "As is the one about your full-on embrace of Malenyevism. My God, if there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."

508.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
508.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Ownership_ForeignOwned"] == true

509.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
509.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Ownership_ForeignOwned"] == true) == false

510.speaker: Player
510.text: "Do you mean Gasom? Because yes, that is a mess."
510.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Ownership_ForeignOwned"] == true

511.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
511.text: "What happened to Gasom was nowhere near my fault. But that's a conversation for another day."

513.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
513.text: "How have you been otherwise? Still trying to lead Sordland out of the mess I made?"
513.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Downsized"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Gasom_Ownership_ForeignOwned"] == true) == false)

514.speaker: Player
514.text: "I think it's safe to say that it's *my* mess now."

515.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
515.text: "You see, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. Being in charge of a country like Sordland isn't as easy as you think."

520.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
520.text: "Don't boast too prematurely. Sordland isn't out of the weeds yet."

521.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
521.text: "There's one particular thorn that still needs pruning..."

522.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
522.text: "And he who is considered a great leader today could end up in shackles tomorrow..."

523.speaker: Player
523.text: "Your mess isn't what keeps me up at night. It's Soll's."

527.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
527.text: "You always did have it in for him. Starting with when you helped oust him from USP leadership."

528.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
528.text: "Or maybe you just wanted to get rid of anyone who stood between you and the Maroon Palace..."

529.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
529.text: "I remember a time when you were eager to support the Colonel. Even at the expense of a new chance at growth for Sordland."

530.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
530.text: "But we all fell victim to his cult of personality at one point or another."

535.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
535.text: "As is the one about how the Sordish economy is in even worse shape than during my presidency. If there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."
535.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] <= 3)

539.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
539.text: "As is the one about the rather dictatorial path you've led the country down. My God, if there's anything Soll and I would agree on..."
539.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] <= 3) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_Dictator_Success"] == true)

540.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
540.text: "Today is all about that man right over there."
540.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] <= 3) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_Dictator_Success"] == true) == false)

542.speaker: Player
542.text: "Yes. You're forgetting about the deep state he established to undermine the democratic institutions of this republic."

543.speaker: Narrator
543.text: The courtroom came alive with chatter. Alphonso stared at me, his mouth wide open.

547.speaker: Player
547.text: "Hell of a second case as Chief Justice, isn't it? I hope the result will be similar to the first."
